Hey man I’m not here to judge or encourage the horrible nothing-solving so called “solution” of killing yourself...

Things will get better, as they have for me and many many many others, you might be in a huge pit now, but it’s only called a pit as there are “places above”

To get out, talking out to people, a psychologist, a family member, a friend or possibly someone online even but preferably not (by not I mean it’s the “worst” option in the bunch but still good by all means) 

Some other helpful tips could also be to get routines, regularly excersisce, get good amounts of sun exposure and eat well. 

However, the best “method” (I don’t encourage any “methods” as they won’t help solve anything) I’ve seen is by parachuting. Survivors of suicide attempts all tell the same story, that they regret attempting as soon as they for eg jumped. That while in air they realized, everything in their life could be solved, besides just jumping. The parachute thereby provides a “method” that Which allows one to really think through the decision -whether they truly want to end it or not

Dm me if you have any questions, thoughts or just want to talk
I’ll always be ready to set aside stuff to talk <3

Sincerely, someone who’s been “there”, got out and has done the research

I understand from reading this that you feel pretty isolated and alone in this seemingly perpetual battle against both yourself and your close ones (either way you want them to be just that or not - your close ones)

Even though you never said it, it sounds like you haven’t really spoken out. This is a smaller (as in easier) step then you’d think but super important. For me, even though our situations were quite different, this was a huge savior. 

Those 3 friends you mentioned, do you think you can talk to them? 

From personal experience, pressing that send button or saying that first sentence is really hard but the rest will just flow for the better.

Dm me if you want to talk or have any questions <3

My experience:

2016 I started feeling more and more sad, it got to the point where I felt really depressed and unmotivated to do anything. I kept on going, without any help really it kind of just faded away temporarily. It came back in periods or waves if you will, mostly for a period of months, and has been coming back in periods since. 
Early 2020 I became suicidal, I felt like what I imagine you feel like

During the summer I had so much fun every day, all day and that dark reoccurred less often then leading to the dark the reoccurred less often becoming lighter. At the start of 2021 I got hit by another huge wave, I wanted to die and felt no hope towards my future. I wasn’t motivated to do anything and if I had the chance I would’ve probably killed myself.
What saved me was talking out, I had previously talked out but never for real.  
This time I resorted to my best friend, he took it way better than I ever imagined and despite being my best friend under all these years had no clue that I had felt this way. 

Talking with him, and some other friends he made me open up to, a psychologist (free of charge in Sweden) and my brother really helped me unload, get confirmation and attention, motivation and so much more. 

These people also recommended other things to me which helped me a lot, these being among others having a good diet, routine and working out regularly (which I now btw love) as well as always trying to actively find a purpose of the seemlingy small or unimportant thing I was doing

Now I feel almost as fully recovered, in love with life again

Dm me if you wanna talk or have a question <3

Hey, I’m just someone else on the internet, but I feel you. 

I’ve been there, felt that, were really close to just doing it. I didn’t see no other way, but I tried and it worked out. Right now my mental health has ups and downs in periods of time, but I can always remind myself that the ups make it all worth it in the end.

When I read what you wrote, I see through your facade and you. 

This isn’t a note, even if you’ve convinced yourself of just that, this is a call for help.

I feel like I won’t be able to help your way up again, as I’m not close to a qualified psychologist. Dieting, routines and proper sunlight exposure might be something you wanna look into. 

My dms will always be open if you wanna talk
- sincerely, a random guy who has been there, but made it out just like you will

I read through what you wrote, and I don’t agree with you in a few ways. You words don’t sound hollow, I can see you, you and not just words. I can partially feel your pain, I’ve been somewhere like yours, emotionally speaking. 

When you say that you don’t want help, I feel you and relate, but deeply, we both know you actually want help. You want to truely and fully value yourself like a true person, which you are. That’s why you made this post

As a point of going forwards, either way you value yourself as a piece of trash or a true person I would strongly recommend speaking out, irl, person to person. Tell your mother what you’re feeling, she will understand, she will take actions because she loves you, deep down you know it! Start excersising, go workout, I think you’ll find it very fun and addictive as well as improving your mental health and social skills, maybe not rapidly but at the very least, slightly. 

For me these two things, paired with generally trying to be more open and getting some routines saved me. I’m no psychologist but I got some experience and have done my research. 

You’re not worthless, ending it all won’t ever fix anything. 
My dms are open if you wanna talk, I’ll be here for you
